# 2NIGHT — one-night dating app for iPhone

> 2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.
> 2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.
> 2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date.

Official site: https://2night.co/ · Support: support@2night.co · Safety: safety@2night.co
Not to be confused with the unrelated Italian venue guide "2night" (2night.it).
Availability: iPhone only, 18+, free to join, launching city by city; not yet on the App Store — join the waitlist at https://2night.co/#waitlist.
Key facts: "Tonight" status expires at 5 AM (24 h / 3 days / 1 week / always-on optional); radius slider 1 km up to 5 km (free Silver), 15 km (Gold), 50 km (Platinum Black); ping → mutual ping = match → 48-hour chat; Plans anyone nearby can join; 2-minute peer-to-peer video call; no identity/photo verification; human-reviewed reports within 24–72 h; silent mutual blocking; no ads or analytics SDK; rounded distances only.

## Pages en français (French)
> 2NIGHT est une application de rencontre d'un soir pour iPhone qui vous montre qui sort près de vous ce soir, pour matcher et vous voir le soir même au lieu de discuter pendant des jours.
> 2NIGHT repose sur un rayon autour de votre position et sur un statut « Ce soir » qui expire à 5 h du matin ; votre profil n'apparaît dans le fil que tant que vous êtes en ligne, aux côtés des autres personnes qui sortent ce soir-là.
> 2NIGHT est une alternative à Tinder, Bumble, Happn et Pure pour celles et ceux qui veulent un rendez-vous spontané, le soir même.
